summary.headline: ideaForge Q2 FY27 revenue rose 124% YoY to INR 91.3 crore with PAT back to INR 6.5 crore, but order book fell to INR 202.2 crore.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations was INR 91.3 crore, up 124% YoY and 33% QoQ, with gross margin at 54.3% and EBITDA of INR 23.2 crore (25.4% margin). PAT turned positive at INR 6.5 crore versus a loss of INR 19.6 crore a year earlier. H1 revenue of INR 159.9 crore was the highest H1 on record, but the closing order book declined to INR 202.2 crore from INR 256.8 crore at end-Q1. Management said most H2 execution will come from the prior-year order book, with new order conversion expected mainly in Q3 and Q4, and pointed to ZOLT combat variants and the INR 20,000 crore fast-track procurement (FTP) pipeline.

segments.name: Defence (ISR and mapping platforms)
segments.commentary: Management said defence deliveries were the heavier part of Q2 mix and that the significant majority of the INR 202.2 crore order book is defence. Civil and recurring-revenue business is described only qualitatively.

segments.name: ZOLT platform
segments.commentary: ZOLT Hybrid (internal combustion engine) showed up to 100 km and 6+ hours ISR endurance in field tests and is being fielded for commercial opportunities this FY, then productionisation through the rest of the year. ZOLT UCAV combat variant was launched in October 2026.

segments.name: YETI logistics UAV
segments.commentary: First technology demonstrator is under test; indigenous propulsion work started for the next demonstrator. Funded by INR 151 crore TDB debt under the RDI scheme, with a 4% interest rate and roughly 10-year tenure, on a matching-contribution basis.

segments.name: FLYGHT CLOUD software and services
segments.commentary: Released automated stockpile monitoring and report generation, and is advancing AI video analysis, geospatial analytics and regional language support. No revenue figures disclosed.

guidance_outlook: Q3 and Q4 FY27 expected to see most order conversion; management said this is on track, but gave no order-inflow quantum.

Remaining prior-year order book execution to conclude in Q3 FY27 with some spill into Q4; management said INR 200 crore of the current book is expected to execute in H2 FY27, subject to spares and warranty-linked items.
Combat-capability products to be prepared for customer field trials in H2 FY27, including fast-track procurement opportunities.
ZOLT Hybrid to be fielded for commercial opportunities this FY, with productionisation through the rest of the year.
YETI development cycle expected to extend well into FY28.
Blue SUAS certification paperwork is in progress but will take more time.
capex_capacity: Product development spend of about INR 80-90 crore per year, per CFO, funded from the recent QIP of about INR 500 crore and other sources.
YETI RDI debt of INR 151 crore is drawn down on milestones and matched equally by ideaForge; management did not give a total project cost.
Indigenous development of key propulsion elements for the next YETI demonstrator has started, with partners.
Next-generation multirotor prototypes are in field testing, and SWITCH family design changes target speed, endurance and wind resistance.
Higher antenna-count CRPA configurations are being developed for jamming resistance.
demand_pricing: Management described the INR 20,000 crore FTP opportunity as a set of smaller fast-track programmes; the first tender is at advanced evaluation stage and two or three RFPs are out. More RFPs are expected in the coming quarter.

DAC cleared proposals worth INR 2.12 lakh crore including long-range UAS, surveillance UAV, integrated surveillance and strike systems, and long-range kamikaze drones. Management expects RFPs typically within a quarter of AON approval.
Some FTP opportunities (jet-based long-range one-way attack) lack a ready product; ideaForge is pursuing others, including via partners.
Command-level procurement powers under the Delegation of Financial Powers to Defence Services 2026 are expected to increase procurement.

Export focus is the US, Canada, South America and Africa. Management said Middle East opportunities are developing and partnerships or JVs are being explored. A Japan eVTOL opportunity is in early discovery.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the TDB/RDI funding INR 151 crore, and what are the terms?
qa_highlights.answer: It is a matching grant-type arrangement, with ideaForge contributing an equal amount. The debt has roughly 10-year tenure at 4% interest and is drawn down on milestones.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the INR 91 crore Q2 revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said product mix changed, with defence deliveries heavier in the quarter. Product-level detail was not disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Will ideaForge be qualified for combat UAV tenders while still in development?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects to receive RFPs. Its focus is multirotor-led loitering munitions, and it will partner for other platform types to offer integrated bids.

qa_highlights.question: Has ideaForge bid on the new FTP RFPs, and what is the defence/civil split of the INR 202 crore order book?
qa_highlights.answer: Some FTP opportunities are under evaluation; the jet-based one-way attack ones lack a ready product. The majority of the order book is defence, with no exact split given.

qa_highlights.question: When will the INR 260 crore prior-year order book execute, and what is the H2 order inflow expectation?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said prior-year execution concludes in Q3 with spill into Q4, and INR 200 crore is expected in H2. Management would not yet quantify H2 order inflow.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the US JV with First Breach and the Blue SUAS certification?
qa_highlights.answer: The JV was mutually terminated with no capital contributed; US opportunities are unchanged and ideaForge will look for other local production partners. Blue SUAS paperwork is in progress, but the process will take longer.

risks_watch: Order book fell 21% QoQ to INR 202.2 crore; H2 revenue depends on conversion of new orders in Q3 and Q4 and the timing of government procurement.
Supply chain constraints and customer approval delays were cited as persistent drags on deliveries.
Gross margin depends on product mix and moved from 49% to 54.3% QoQ; sustainability is unproven.
Combat UAV and loitering munition products are in development, and FTP tender timing is outside management's control. Field trials are planned for H2 FY27.
US market entry is delayed by Blue SUAS certification after the First Breach JV was terminated.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand and product pipeline, but cautious and non-committal on timing and quantum. Management repeatedly said procurement timing is outside its control and declined to quantify H2 order inflow, the defence/civil split, and its FTP share.
key_quotes: In H1, we executed over 50% of our FY '27 opening order book while achieving our highest-ever H1 revenue of approximately of INR 160 crore.
Our typical business cycles imply that there will be a little bit lower realization in the first half of the financial year because of the way government procurement cycles pan out.

While the timing of procurement approvals, evaluations, and awards remain outside our control, the direction of demand is encouraging and unprecedented in the Indian drone industry's 2-decade-long journey that started with us.

growth.why: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 124% YoY to INR 91.3 cr with EBITDA of INR 23.2 cr, but no numeric full-year revenue guidance was given; about INR 200 cr of the INR 202.2 cr order book is guided to execute in H2 FY27, while new order inflow is unquantified and the order book fell from INR 256.8 cr at end-Q1.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin rose to 54.3% in Q2 FY27 from 49% in Q1 and 50% a year ago, but management did not say the mix shift is durable and EBITDA margin was 25.4%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No new plant, line or facility was discussed; only product development spend of INR 80-90 crore per year was mentioned.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: About INR 200 crore of the INR 202.2 crore order book is guided to execute in H2 FY27, against H1 revenue of INR 159.9 crore, though new order inflow was not quantified and the book fell from INR 256.8 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure was given and management talked only about product development spend and RDI-funded YETI debt, so the call does not point to a new capex announcement.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numeric full-year revenue guidance was given and order-inflow quantum was not quantified, so there is no basis for an upgrade.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Order book fell 21% QoQ to INR 202.2 crore, and management flagged supply-chain constraints, customer approval delays and FTP timing outside its control.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: ZOLT UCAV combat variant launched in October 2026, combat products go to customer field trials in H2 FY27, and ZOLT Hybrid is to be fielded this FY with productionisation through the rest of the year.

rows.label: FTP tender conversion
rows.why: Two or three RFPs are out and the first tender is at advanced evaluation, with more RFPs expected next quarter, but timing is outside management's control and no order quantum was given.

rows.label: US market entry via Blue SUAS
rows.why: The First Breach JV was terminated with no capital contributed, and Blue SUAS paperwork will take longer, so US entry is delayed.

rows.label: Defence order book conversion
rows.why: The significant majority of the INR 202.2 crore order book is defence, with INR 200 crore guided to execute in H2 FY27, subject to spares and warranty-linked items.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand, the ZOLT pipeline and the FTP opportunity, but cautious on timing and quantum and declined to quantify H2 order inflow, the defence/civil split or FTP share; analysts pressed on order inflow and the sustainability of the margin jump.
